cover.kicker: It can be a legal duty.

lines.show: Your colleague smells of alcohol on shift
lines.say: Your colleague smells of alcohol on shift.
Pause. Do you report it, or keep it quiet?

lines.show: Report it. It can be a legal duty to notify the regulator
lines.say: Report it. Practising while intoxicated can be a legal duty to notify.

lines.show: It is about patient safety, not punishment
lines.say: It's about keeping patients safe, not punishing anyone.

lines.show: Write down what you saw, factually
lines.say: Write down what you saw, factually.

lines.show: Never treat it as an HR matter only
lines.say: And never treat it as just an HR matter.
